location.description: Location to simulate search from (e.g., "Austin, Texas")

numResults.description: Number of results to return per page

page.description: Page number (0-indexed offset for Google, 1-indexed for others)

dateRange.description: Date range filter (e.g., "d" for past day, "w" for past week, "m" for past month, "y" for past year)

noCache.description: Force fresh results instead of cached

timeTaken.description: Time taken to process the search in seconds

query.description: Image search query (required unless using imageUrl for reverse image search)

imageUrl.description: URL of an image for reverse image search (Google Lens). When provided, query is optional.

isProduct.description: Whether the image is a product

query.description: News search query (required unless using topicToken, storyToken, or publicationToken)

topicToken.description: Google News topic token for browsing specific topics (mutually exclusive with query)

storyToken.description: Google News story token for a specific story

publicationToken.description: Google News publication token for a specific publication

topicToken.description: Token for navigating to this topic

sortBy.description: YouTube sort/filter token (e.g., "CAI=" for upload date)

isLive.description: Whether the video is currently live

nextPageToken.description: Token for fetching the next page of results (YouTube)

amazonDomain.description: Amazon domain (e.g., "amazon.co.uk"). Only used with amazon engine.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed for Amazon/Walmart)

isPrime.description: Whether the product has Prime shipping (Amazon)

query.description: Search query (e.g., "pizza near me", "hotels in Paris")

dataCid.description: Google CID to look up a specific place directly

page.description: Page number for pagination (0-indexed, increments of 20)

placeDetails.description: Detailed place information (when looking up a specific place)

returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format (omit for one-way)

tripType.description: Type of trip (round trip, one way)
Type of trip (round trip, one way)

cites.description: Google Scholar result ID to find papers that cite this paper

authorId.description: Google Scholar author ID to retrieve author profile and publications

yearLow.description: Filter results from this year onward

yearHigh.description: Filter results up to this year

page.description: Page number (0-indexed, each page has ~10 results)

sortByDate.description: Sort results by date instead of relevance

pdfLink.description: Direct link to PDF if available

authorProfile.description: Author profile information (when searching by authorId)

query.description: Search term to analyze trends for (required unless fetching trending searches)

dataType.description: Type of trends data to retrieve

timeRange.description: Time range (e.g., "today 12-m" for past 12 months, "today 5-y" for past 5 years, "2020-01-01 2023-12-31" for custom range)

location.description: Location to search in (e.g., "New York, NY")

chips.description: Filter chips for refining results (e.g., date posted, job type)

jobId.description: Google Jobs job ID for detailed lookup

chipsFilters.description: Available filter chips for refining search

query.description: Partial search query to get suggestions for

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 10)
